title: Interclude
summary: INTERCLU'DE, verb transitive [Latin intercludo; inter and cludo, to shut.] 1. To shut from a place or course by something intervening; to intercept. 2. To cut off; to interrupt.

inlines.v: INTERCLU'DE, verb transitive [Latin intercludo; inter and cludo, to shut.] 1. To shut from a place or course by something intervening; to intercept. 2. To cut off; to interrupt.
